description: Flood-risk information around a point in France from Géorisques (French Ministry of Ecological Transition): the flood hazards recorded for the commune at the point, the flood-zone atlases (AZI) covering communes within the radius, and any significant-flood-risk territory (TRI) in range. These are risk-record listings, not parcel-level flood polygons, so absence of a record is not proof of no flood risk.
name: fr_flood_zones
